points.quote: Incomappleux River FSR Road Deactivation Prescription Map Sections 1, 3, and 4

map_readings.label: Incomappleux River FSR Road Deactivation Prescription Map Sections 1, 3, and 4
map_readings.shows: Map title block, dated November 12, 2024 under the datum note. A table beside it lists Road Section and Length (m): Section 1 10431m, Section 3 663m, Section 4 225m. The legend entry 'Deactivation Prescription' is an orange line, which is drawn along the road from the south end of the map to the north end near Stephney Creek. Small road labels along the road are too small to read reliably, so no file number is given.

map_readings.label: WP 1-1 = POT End of deactivation Branch 1
map_readings.shows: Point of Termination marker at the north end of the orange deactivation line, at the Stephney Creek crossing.

map_readings.label: Road Previously Deactivated
map_readings.shows: Callout pointing to the grey road continuing north beyond Stephney Creek, past the end of the orange deactivation line.

map_readings.label: Bridge Previously Removed
map_readings.shows: Callout at the Stephney Creek crossing at the north end of the deactivation line.

map_readings.label: WP 1-11 = N5-037 RB/RNSC Bridge Removal, restore natural stream channel
map_readings.shows: Bridge Removal symbol (red X) on the orange deactivation line south of Scott Creek.

map_readings.label: WP 1-14 = N5-036 RB/RNSC Remove bridge and restore natural stream channel.
map_readings.shows: Bridge crossing on the orange deactivation line marked for removal.

map_readings.label: WP 1-15A = N5-035 RB/RNSC See Appendix A for deactivation prescription
map_readings.shows: Bridge Removal symbol (red X) on the orange deactivation line where it crosses a river channel.

map_readings.label: WP 4-1 = No works required on this road
map_readings.shows: Callout on a short side road branching off the orange deactivation line near the WP 1-15 bridge.

map_readings.label: WP 3-7 = ISP Junction with Branch 1. Install deactivation sign and signpost
map_readings.shows: Point where the Section 3 road joins the orange deactivation line; deactivation sign and signpost to be installed.

map_readings.label: WP 1-22B = N5-034 Bridge
map_readings.shows: Bridge Removal symbol (red X) on the orange deactivation line in the private land area.

map_readings.label: WP 1-25 = PFM/OS Start of pull back section. Partial pull back required over steepened fill. Out slope road surface.
map_readings.shows: Start of the hatched Pull Back Section along the orange deactivation line near the Incomappleux River.

map_readings.label: WP 1-29 = N5-125 RB Remove bridge.
map_readings.shows: Bridge Removal symbol (red X) on the orange deactivation line near its south end.

map_readings.label: WP 1-30 = ISP/IAB Install deactivation sign and sign post. Install lock block wall.
map_readings.shows: Install Deactivation Sign/Post and Access symbol at the south end of the orange deactivation line.
